newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Labuan offshore insurance triples in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Labuan offshore insurance triples in 1996.

text.p: The governing authority for Malaysia's offshore financial centre at Labuan island announced that assets of insurance companies registered with them more than tripled in 1996 over the previous year.
The Labuan Offshore Financial Services Authority (LOFSA) said in its annual report for 1996 that assets of the 11 insurance companies stood at $138.2 million at the end of last year.
Total capitalisation of the offshore insurance industry was $105.9 million against $24.3 million at the beginning of 1995.
"The bulk of the increase... was mainly attributable to injection of capital as a result of the restructuring of Malaysian-Re International Insurance (L) Ltd," LOFSA said.
The 11 companies' gross premium increased to $35.8 million last year from $6.4 million in 1995, it said.
